title_en: Building Collapse in Delhi Leaves Up to 50 Residents Missing
title_hi: दिल्ली में इमारत ढहने से 50 तक लोग गुम
summary_en: A five‑storey hostel in Delhi collapsed, with officials estimating that up to 50 occupants may be trapped. Rescue teams have been deployed and are searching for survivors, while authorities have not yet identified the cause of the collapse.

title_en: Volcano eruption leaves 170,000 passengers stranded in Indonesia
title_hi: Volcano eruption leaves 170,000 passengers stranded in Indonesia
summary_en: More than 170,000 airline passengers are stranded after ash was detected in airspace near Jakarta following the eruptions.

title_en: German far-right set for big win in eastern state - projections
title_hi: German far-right set for big win in eastern state - projections
summary_en: Germany's AfD has hailed a "historic result" and is projected to win more than 44% of the vote, far ahead of the conservative CDU on 18.4%.

title_en: US Envoys Hold Substantive Talks with Zelensky in Kyiv After Meeting Putin
title_hi: पुतिन के साथ बैठक के बाद अमेरिकी प्रतिनिधिमंडल ने कीव में जेलेंस्की से चर्चा की
summary_en: A U.S. delegation led by Steve Witkoff met Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in Kyiv on Thursday, following a separate meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin. The American team described the dialogue as "substantive" and "important," and said they felt encouraged by the exchange. The talks are being viewed as a notable step in diplomatic efforts to address the ongoing conflict in the region.

title_en: Sachin Pilot Has His Task Cut Out - Unite Factions Before Rahul Gandhi Visit
title_hi: Sachin Pilot Has His Task Cut Out - Unite Factions Before Rahul Gandhi Visit
summary_en: As the person in charge, Baghel was expected to bring these factions together to strengthen the party. He, however, failed in this task, and there were allegations that he effectively became a faction unto himself.

title_en: Russia Accuses Germany of Renewed War Intent, Denies Involvement in Leipzig Airport Attack
title_hi: रूस ने जर्मनी पर फिर से युद्ध की मंशा का आरोप लगाया, लीपज़िग हवाई अड्डे के हमले में अपना इनकार किया
summary_en: Moscow said Berlin is seeking war again, while rejecting accusations that Russia was involved in the recent attack on Leipzig Airport. Both sides have closed each other's cultural centres, and EU member states have summoned Russian diplomats amid the escalating diplomatic row.

title_en: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay Prioritizes State Anthem Over Centre’s Vande Mataram Push
title_hi: तमिलनाडु मुख्यमंत्री विजय ने केंद्र के वंदे मातरम अभियान के सामने राज्य गीत को प्राथमिकता दी
summary_en: Chief Minister Vijay reiterated that the Tamil state anthem must be given top priority in Tamil Nadu and that his administration will not compromise on linguistic rights. The statement comes as the central government intensifies its promotion of Vande Mataram as a national song. Officials confirmed the stance reflects the state’s long‑standing policy to protect regional language heritage.

title_en: Delhi Auctions 2,000 Confiscated Vehicles, Generates Rs 5 Crore
title_hi: दिल्ली ने 2,000 जब्त वाहन नीलाम कर Rs 5 करोड़ प्राप्त किए
summary_en: The Delhi Excise Department auctioned 2,000 vehicles seized under excise regulations, fetching a total of Rs 5 crore. The sale was conducted according to the Delhi Excise Rules, which mandate that confiscated assets be sold to the highest bidder.

title_en: Israel Orders Evacuation of Unauthorized West Bank Settlements
title_hi: इज़राइल ने अनधिकृत पश्चिमी तट बस्तियों का ख़ाली करने का आदेश दिया
summary_en: The Israeli government announced that Prime Minister Netanyahu has ordered the evacuation of several West Bank settlements that were established without official approval. These outposts are deemed illegal under both international law and Israeli statutes, marking a notable shift in settlement policy.

title_en: Delhi Building Collapse Claims Five Lives, Eleven Rescued; FIR Filed Against Owner
title_hi: दिल्ली में इमारत गिरने से पाँच मौतें, ग्यारह बचाए; मालिक के खिलाफ FIR दर्ज
summary_en: A five‑storey building in Delhi collapsed, killing at least five people and rescuing eleven from the rubble. Police are filing an FIR against the building's owner, Anand Bansal of Hostel Daze, as investigations reveal ongoing basement repairs and reports of a weak foundation with water seepage.

title_en: Renowned Carnatic Musician S.R. Janakiraman Dies at 98
title_hi: प्रख्यात कर्नाटक संगीतकार एसआर जनकीरामण का 98 वर्ष की आयु में निधन
summary_en: Veteran Carnatic vocalist and scholar S.R. Janakiraman, aged 98, passed away in Chennai. He was celebrated for his erudite lectures and practical demonstrations that shaped the December music festival season for decades. His death marks the loss of a pivotal figure in the transmission of Carnatic tradition.

title_en: India and China Conduct First Corps‑Commander Dialogue in Arunachal Pradesh
title_hi: भारत‑चीन ने अरुणाचल में पहला कॉर्‍प्स कमांडर संवाद किया
summary_en: India and China held their inaugural meeting of senior corps commanders in Arunachal Pradesh, a few days before the BRICS summit where President Xi Jinping is slated to attend. The talks, convened amid reports of heightened activity in the Taksing sector, marked an expansion of the existing military dialogue framework along the disputed border.

title_en: 29 Contestants Finalized for Bigg Boss Tamil Season 10 After Public Poll Trims List to 19
title_hi: जनमत सर्वेक्षण के बाद बिग बॉस तमिल सिजन 10 के लिए 29 में से 19 प्रतियोगियों को अंतिम रूप
summary_en: A total of 29 participants were initially shortlisted for the upcoming tenth season of Bigg Boss Tamil. Following a live audience poll, ten contestants were eliminated, leaving 19 finalists—including Lakshmi Priya, Chandini, Raaghav and Pandi—to compete in the premiere.

title_en: Four Kalady Police Officers Suspended Over Custodial Torture Allegations
title_hi: कलाड़ी में चार पुलिस अधिकारियों को अभिरक्षा यातना के आरोप में निलंबित किया गया
summary_en: Four police officers in Kalady have been suspended after a taxi driver filed a complaint alleging they brutally assaulted him when he was taken into custody on September 2 in connection with a case involving a friend. The department has launched an inquiry to verify the claims and determine further disciplinary action.
